findings.observed: Real authenticated owner pending inquiry is active while persistent case header says No case selected and workspace access-denied banner remains.
findings.plan_requirement: One authoritative authenticated case/actor/privacy context reconciles the header, navigation, and actions after login and case selection; stale failure UI clears only after verified success.

findings.observed: Sidebar says Complete while zero answers are saved and five elements need support.
findings.plan_requirement: Distinguish transport/hydration success, saved state, unresolved interview, review readiness, and legal sufficiency; no generic Complete label for an unresolved case.

findings.observed: The pending question is a form surrounded by raw inquiry/objective ids, internal target paths and verbose provenance. Mobile answer controls fall below technical explanation text.
findings.plan_requirement: Conversation-first current question with compact why/source disclosure; chat and rich modes share one encrypted session and preserve unknown/defer/correct actions.

findings.observed: Several large guidance panels precede the evidence form; the form exposes one hardcoded claim-element selector and no visible evidence preview/library in this viewport.
findings.plan_requirement: Evidence library/master-detail with preview, upload status, user comments, versioned classifier proposals and explicit claim linkage; separate suggestions from adopted facts.

findings.observed: Opening a conversation requires raw case/thread/membership ids, versions, and polling interval; senders appear as opaque ids and protocol notes dominate the page.
findings.plan_requirement: Case-scoped inbox/timeline with friendly verified actor labels, explicit AI versus human attribution, read/reply states, attachments/context links and hidden transport controls.

findings.observed: The account table is visibly clipped on mobile; role changes and disable actions sit alongside raw ids. Masked credential remains populated after successful login.
findings.plan_requirement: Responsive account summaries/search, contextual detail/action menus, accessible guarded role/status workflows and credential clearing after verification.

findings.observed: The scoped lawyer page is a sparse repeated authorization form plus raw revision/request/proposal fields; this baseline has not shared a content envelope.
findings.plan_requirement: Assigned-case review queue and explicit owner sharing/recipient acceptance workflow with readable revision/status context; preserve content closure until actual grant/key admission.

findings.observed: Workspace uses a large branded hero/cards while correspondence/admin use largely default HTML forms and unrelated page structures.
findings.plan_requirement: One app shell, typography/spacing/token system, consistent navigation, focus/error patterns, empty/loading/locked/unavailable states and responsive layout.

information_architecture.entry: Case list and actionable case status
role_areas: Operational admin account and audit area without case-content bypass

limitations: Lawyer assignment is accepted through real UI; owner review envelope is not shared in this baseline, so closed/unavailable content is not depicted as opened.
The existing workspace header can still show No case selected/access denied after actual backend authentication and case-context bootstrap; the functional pending inquiry below is real.
Evidence screenshots show genuine unsaved form, not successful upload, annotation, classifier, or replication.
Draft view is a real blocked/not-generated state; no generated complaint is fabricated.
All cases, actors, source text, credentials, keys and messages are newly authored synthetic fixtures.
